reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and I reorder my usual brand when it runs out. I don't need it in a sachet to go, and I'm not switching for a brand I've never heard of.
objection: I already have a magnesium I trust and a routine for it. Made in China from an unknown brand is one more reason to stay with what I have.
would_change_my_mind: If my current magnesium sold out or went up a lot in price, or if I started traveling often and needed something portable.
